Row.Text: "Swinging gleaming blades will cleave you into bamboo chips!"
"Which door leads to fortune and which to misfortune? The result is determined by people."
"As the lotus withers, the chrysanthemums bloom. Long sadness, short days – then winter turns to spring."
"The path to fame is one amid a hundred paths to failure."
